text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Gentildonna—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Gentildonna pointed,
I see a crane game filled with plushies
modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Buena-san was talking about
that earlier, wasn't she? Maybe I should take some home as a souvenir."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Gentildonna decided to give it a try,
but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: This machine's claw is so flimsy...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And the levers, too...
If I lose focus, I feel like I'll snap them right off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems being worried about its durability is preventing him from playing at full strength.
choice_data_list: Shall I go get it for you?
Shall I get it for you instead?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you ready?
I'll leave the delicate plays to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
